async def act(page):
    # Click Next on the Bulk Images & Price step to proceed to Summary step
    next_button = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Create Product Configurations").get_by_role("button", name="Next")
    await next_button.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for the dialog to update to Summary step
    
    # Now on Summary step, click Next again to create configurations
    # Assuming the same Next button is present and leads to creation
    next_button_summary = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Create Product Configurations").get_by_role("button", name="Next")
    await next_button_summary.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for configurations to be created and dialog to close
    
    # After this, the dialog should close and configurations are added
    return "Proceeded through Bulk Images & Price and Summary steps to add blue to sizes S and M"
